GF1024: one kilobit

You will learn

The widest rung of the family, 1 + 391 + 632, and the test that names it.

GF1024 has 1024 bits: 1 sign, 391 exponent, 632 mantissa. Its ratio E / M is 0.6187, a distance of 0.0006 from 1 / phi, and the family spec has a test that names GF1024 as the format with the smallest phi distance. It is a rung of the family on paper; no hardware in this course computes in it.

Try it

Find PHI_DIST in gf1024.t27. Then in goldenfloat_family.t27 find the test about GF1024 and the function it calls.
